'Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun' Reveals Main Staff, Teaser Promo, 2027 Debut
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Naruki's Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun (Glasses with a Chance of Delinquent) manga revealed the main staff, two teaser visuals (pictured above), and teaser promotional video on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027. 'Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor: EZY' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, File 3 Teaser Trailer
The official website for the Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor: EZY (Patlabor The Mobile Police: EZY) anime revealed an additional cast pair, File 3 key visual (pictured), and teaser trailer on Tuesday. The first installment opened in theaters on May 15, and the second installment is scheduled to premiere on August 14. File 3 movie is planned for a March 5, 2027 opening.
